Package index

Fitting

zisar() zisar_fit()
Fit a zero-inflated spatial autoregressive (ZISAR) model
zisar_basis() print(<zisar_basis>)
Basis of a reduced-rank inflation field
zisar_effects() print(<zisar_effects>)
Direct, indirect and total effects of a ZISAR model

Methods for fitted models

coef(<zisar>) vcov(<zisar>) logLik(<zisar>) nobs(<zisar>) fitted(<zisar>) print(<zisar>) summary(<zisar>) print(<summary.zisar>)
Methods for fitted ZISAR models
predict(<zisar>)
Predictions from a fitted ZISAR model
residuals(<zisar>)
Residuals of a fitted ZISAR model
simulate(<zisar>)
Simulate responses from a fitted ZISAR model

Simulation and spatial weights

rzisar()
Simulate data from the ZISAR model
lattice_weights()
Spatial weights for a regular lattice
